ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB=AC$, $\angle ABC=45^\circ$, $AD\perp BC$ at point D. If $BC=8$, what is the length of $AD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB=AC$ and $AD\perp BC$,\\
it follows that $BD=DC=4$,\\
since $\angle ABC=45^\circ$ and $AD\perp BC$,\\
it results in $\angle ABD=\angle BAD=45^\circ$,\\
thus $AD=BD=\boxed{4}$.
